name: Warp Pillar

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-16: A Star's Journey

stealth.details: (trained); DC 18 Perception check to realize the pillars can move, noticing the pillar has a DC of 0.

disable: DC 18 Arcana check, DC 18 Crafting check, DC 18 Occultism check, or DC 18 Thievery check; three successes deactivates a pillar, as does destroying it.
reset: If the pillar isn't destroyed, it resets 1 minute after making no time drain attacks.
routine: (two actions) The pillar Steps or Strides to get as close to as many targets as possible, then makes a time drain Strike against each creature within its reach.

items.name: Time Shift
items.text:
Trigger A creature attacks the pillar or approaches within 5 feet of it, or the other warp pillar activates

---
Effect The trap casts Slow (DC 18 Fortitude save) on a random creature within 30 feet, then rolls initiative.

text: A time-disrupting field shimmers around a 9-foot-tall pillar of obsidian and bronze that magically slides across the room.
